betterquesting:10.desc:8:
The IQ Edition Official Pack contains many extra mods to help with an average player's progression. Some of these are:

§6FindIt:§r Pressing T in the inventory allows you to locate items in chests.

§6Backhand: §rAllows you to hold an item in your offhand, like Modern MC.

§6Adventure Backpacks:§r Adds backpacks craftable and found in structures and chests, allowing you to store items as well as keep your tools ready.

§6BetterQuesting:§r The mod which allows you to read this questbook! Invite your friends to your quest party (Party in the main menu of the questbook) to share QuestBook progression.[warn] NOTE: This may not work well on LAN servers or E4MC.[/warn]

§6Inventory Sorting:§r Middle click or press the sort button to instantly sort your inventory.
§6
Extreme Sound Muffler:§r Lets you selectively muffle sounds in your surroundings.

§6Gravestone:§r Saves all your items on death as a gravestone.

§6ItemPhysic:§r Makes dropping items a bit more appealing visually and allows you to adjust the throwing distance of your items.

§6Minemoticon:§r Adds emojis to minecraft text!

§6SignPicture:§r Allows you to place urls on signs to load custom images.

§6Schematica:§r Allows you to save, load, and build schematics for building.

§6§6DuraDispla§yy:§f Shows your durability in the hotbar.
